name: Jim Friery
bio: Jim Friery is a Ventura County singer-songwriter who has lived here since 1978. His sets mix country, folk and classic rock with his own songs, which draw on his life, the places he loves and the people he meets. He plays solo around the county and also plays bluegrass, including Thursdays with the Boatyard Bluegrass Jam Band in Ventura.
source: public web search and the band's public Instagram profile, 2026-10-29
